unlisted_practices: Automated Docker-based deployment of critical care databases with web analytics interfaces (Metabase, Superset)
Fine-tuning an LLM on ICU data to generate SQL queries from natural-language requests, using LangChain and AutoGen

screen.reason: Describes the development and technical demonstration of a platform (ICU-GPT) that uses LLMs and multi-agent frameworks (AutoGen/LangChain) to help clinicians query critical care databases via natural language to SQL, without evaluating an organizational safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
